_comment: 라이브 프레젠테이션 v2 에셋 (sprite-gen gen --provider codex). pose는 3단계 실천가 그림을 참고로 상황별 자세를 그린다.
pose_base: The exact same character as the reference image: same face, same navy hair with the light-blue whale-spout antenna and small orange ball, same outfit (navy hooded jacket with light-blue lining, white hoodie, navy shorts, white sneakers) and the same clean bright anime illustration style with crisp lines. Full body, centered, whole character visible including feet. No background scenery, no floor, no shadow, no text.

poses.wave: Standing and waving hello with one hand and a big friendly smile, welcoming the audience.
poses.explain: Standing three-quarter view, one arm extended to the side with an open palm as if presenting information on a board next to them, confident smile.
poses.think: Standing with one hand on the chin, eyes looking up thoughtfully, a small light-blue question mark floating above the head.
poses.write: Holding an open notebook in one hand and a pen in the other, writing a plan with a focused happy expression.
poses.tablet: Holding a tablet with both hands, looking at its glowing screen with curiosity and interest.
poses.raise: Raising one hand high as if eagerly volunteering an answer, cheerful open-mouth smile.
poses.cheer: Jumping happily with both arms raised high in celebration, eyes closed with joy.

backgrounds.bg-title: Wide landscape 16:9 illustration background for a presentation title slide: a calm bright ocean horizon under a soft light-blue sky, gentle waves along the bottom, a few water splashes and bubbles, a distant small whale tail splashing on the far right, a large clean empty area on the left two-thirds for title text. Flat modern anime background art, palette of navy, light blue, white with tiny orange accents. No text, no people, no logos.
backgrounds.bg-s1: Wide landscape 16:9 illustration background: soft underwater scene with gentle light rays from the surface and floating bubbles, a few glowing light-bulb shaped bubbles suggesting ideas, large clean empty space in the center for text. Flat modern anime background art, navy, light blue and white with tiny orange accents. No text, no people.
backgrounds.bg-s2: Wide landscape 16:9 illustration background: a path of round stepping stones crossing calm sea water and rising like stairs toward a bright lighthouse on the right, soft morning sky, large clean empty space on the left for text. Flat modern anime background art, navy, light blue and white with tiny orange accents. No text, no people.
backgrounds.bg-s3: Wide landscape 16:9 illustration background: small floating islands connected by light bridges and glowing data lines like a friendly network platform over the sea, soft sky, large clean empty space on the left for text. Flat modern anime background art, navy, light blue and white with tiny orange accents. No text, no people.
backgrounds.bg-s4: Wide landscape 16:9 illustration background: an open treasure-map style chart of an ocean with a dotted route between islands, a compass rose and a small flag at the goal, soft paper and sea colors, large clean empty space on the left for text. Flat modern anime background art, navy, light blue and white with tiny orange accents. No text, no people.

icon_sheet.name: icons
icon_sheet.prompt: A clean icon set: exactly 12 separate flat illustrated icons arranged in a neat grid of 4 columns and 3 rows, each icon centered in its own equal cell with generous empty space between icons, nothing touching. Consistent soft modern style with rounded shapes, navy and light blue with small orange accents, subtle shading, no text, no letters, no numbers. Row 1: (1) two caring hands holding a small heart, (2) a young green sprout growing from soil with a sparkle, (3) a teacher badge medal with a star, (4) an open book with a graduation cap. Row 2: (5) a classroom chalkboard with a small chart, (6) two speech bubbles overlapping, (7) a map pin network connecting three locations, (8) a small rocket launching with a light bulb. Row 3: (9) a magnifying glass over a radar chart, (10) a route map with a dotted path and a flag, (11) a stack of digital cards with a play button, (12) a group of three simple people silhouettes in a circle.
